questions.question:
What among the following is FALSE about the Richter scale?

A. It was developed by Charles Richter and Gutengberg in 1935.

B. It is a logarithmic scale

C. It can be measured using a seismometer

D. Magnitude of 8-9 on a Richter scale means it is a micro earthquake.
questions.solution:
Option **2** is correct.

 
• Richter scale is a quantitative measurement of the magnitude of an Earthquake. 
 
• It was developed by **Charles Richter and Gutenberg in 1935**.
 
• It is a **logarithmic scale** and can be **measured using a seismometer**.
 
• As it is a logarithmic scale, each whole-number increase on the scale represents a tenfold increase in measured amplitude.
 
• **Magnitude level of 8 and higher** on a Richter scale means it is a **very major earthquake** and would cause destruction and loss over large areas.
 
• Magnitude level of 5.0-5.9 is considered a moderate and **magnitude level less than 1.0 to 2.9 is considered a micro-level earthquake** and it is generally not felt by people.

questions.question:
What is the device that converts digital signals into analog signals?

A. WiFi

B. Modem

C. Port

D. USB
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Modem**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **modem__** converts the digital signal into an analog signal. 
 
• It stands for Modulator-Demodulator.
 
• In day to day activity, it allows a computer or another device, such as a router to connect to the Internet.
 
• As the name suggests, it first modulates and then demodulates.
 
• It converts (modulates) an analog signal from a telephone or cable wire to digital data of 1s and 0s. This digital data is recognized by a computer.
 
• Then, it converts (demodulates) digital data from a computer into an analog signal that can be sent over standard telephone lines.

⇒ 7x = 63

∴ Required Ratio = 54 ∶ 27 = 2 ∶ 1

questions.question:
Zero degree centigrade is equal to what degree Fahrenheit?

A. 100°F

D. 32°F
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct.

__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Temperature: It is the measure of the degree of hotness and coldness of a body.

 
 
• The SI unit of temperature is Kelvin (K).
 
 
 
• The various temperature scales commonly used are Celsius (C), Kelvin (K), Fahrenheit (F), and Rankine (Ra).
 
• Celsius: It has 100 degrees between the freezing and boiling points of water. 
 
 
• Here 0° represents the freezing point and 100° represents the boiling point. In many countries, celsius is used to communicate day to day temperatures.
 
 
 
• **Fahrenheit:** The Fahrenheit scale was proposed by physicist Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit in 1724. 
 
 
• This scale is primarily used in the United States and some Caribbean countries to communicate day to day temperatures.
 
 

The temperature T in degrees Fahrenheit (°F) is equal to the temperature T in degrees Celsius (°C) times 9/5 plus 32:

°F={{9over5}°C+32}

CALCULATION__:

Given that:

Temperature (T) = 0 °C

Use the above-given formula:

°F={{9over5}×0+32=0+32=32°F}

__EXTRA POINTS__:

To convert **Celcius into Kelvin scale**:

K = C + 273.15

 
• The temperature which shows the same measurement in Celcius and Fahrenheit scale = -40.
 
• The temperature which shows the same measurement in Kelvin and Fahrenheit scale = 574.25.

questions.question:
The LCM of two consecutive even numbers is 144, find the numbers?

A. 16 and 18

B. 14 and 16

C. 18 and 20

D. 22 and 24
questions.solution:
Let, the numbers be x and (x + 2)

We know, HCF of two consecutive even numbers = 2

Also, LCM × HCF = Product of numbers

According to the question,

x × (x + 2) = 144 × 2

⇒ x² + 2x – 288 = 0

⇒ x² + 18x – 16x – 288 = 0

⇒ x(x + 18) – 16(x + 18) = 0

⇒ (x + 18) (x – 16) = 0

⇒ x = - 18 or 16

∴ The numbers are 16 and (16 + 2) = 18
